Hi Michael,

Thanks again for running point on the renewal QBR. We're aiming to make the roadmap demo useful for two distinct audiences on our side: technical ops (platform/infra) and the product committee (exec + PMs). Instead of one long session, can we sequence the demo into two focused blocks and confirm ops contingencies?

- Can you share a lightweight runbook that lists backup hosts, recording policy, and a fallback plan if the live demo hits a perf regression?

Appreciate a proposed cadence and any prerequisites we should surface to procurement ahead of time.

Proposed cadence (same day):
- 10:30–11:15 PT (13:30–14:15 ET) — Technical ops deep-dive (30–45 min + 15 min buffer)
- 14:00–14:45 ET — Exec walkthrough (45 min)

- Backup hosts: marissa.coordinated-ops (warm standby), sean_oncall as escalation
- Recording policy: live recording will be enabled; we can provide a redacted recording within 48 hours
- Fallback: auto-fallback to trimmed demo (no live indexing) + static data slides if LLM latency > 800ms
